#2026 data
```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(tidyverse)
fish = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 1)
ki = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 2)
cover = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 3)
koa = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 4)

fish <- fish %>%
  rename(plot_type = arkev_type)

ki <- ki %>%
  rename(plot_type = arkev_type)

cover <- cover %>%
  rename(plot_type = arkev_type)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

clean_survey_metadata <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      site = str_to_lower(str_trim(site)),
      site = str_replace_all(site, " ", "_"),
      plot_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(plot_type)),
      arkev_unit = str_trim(arkev_unit)
    )
}

fish  <- clean_survey_metadata(fish)
ki    <- clean_survey_metadata(ki)
cover <- clean_survey_metadata(cover)
```

```{r}
survey_key <- c("date", "site", "plot_type", "arkev_unit")

# Check duplicate survey keys
fish %>%
  count(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_with_multiple_rows = sum(n > 1),
    max_rows_per_survey = max(n)
  )

ki %>%
  count(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cover %>%
  count(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
```

```{r}
# Number of unique surveys in each dataset
fish %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  nrow()

ki %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  nrow()

cover %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  nrow()
```

```{r}
fish_surveys <- fish %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key)))

ki_surveys <- ki %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key)))

cover_surveys <- cover %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key)))
```

```{r}
anti_join(fish_surveys, ki_surveys, by = survey_key)

anti_join(ki_surveys, fish_surveys, by = survey_key)

anti_join(cover_surveys, ki_surveys, by = survey_key)

anti_join(ki_surveys, cover_surveys, by = survey_key)
```

#2025 data
```{r}
surveys_2025 = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1i3KlFK9ZlCHW7vNudpcN0kkriUDP4IahfxkR6CVGroQ/edit?gid=0#gid=0')

surveys_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    site = str_to_lower(str_trim(site)),
    site = str_replace_all(site, " ", "_"),
    ARKEV_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(plot_type)),
    ARKEV_unit = str_trim(ARKEV_unit),
    data_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(data_type)),
    species_code = str_to_upper(str_trim(species_code))
    )

survey_key_2025 <- c(
  "year",
  "date",
  "site",
  "ARKEV_type",
  "ARKEV_unit"
)
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(
      paste(year, month, day, sep = "-")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%
  count(data_type, sort = TRUE)
surveys_2025 %>%
  count(data_type, species_code, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    count_num = as.numeric(unlist(count)),
    percent_num = as.numeric(unlist(percent))
  )

surveys_2025 %>%
  summarise(
    count_class = class(count_num),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(count_num))
  )
```


```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type == "kelp") %>%
  count(species_code, wt = count_num, sort = TRUE)

surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type == "inverts") %>%
  count(species_code, wt = count_num, sort = TRUE)

surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type %in% c("urchins", "tegula")) %>%
  count(data_type, species_code, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  rename(arkev_unit = ARKEV_unit) %>%
  mutate(year = 2025)

surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    survey_id = paste(
      date,
      site,
      plot_type,
      arkev_unit,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(
    data_type == "kelp",
    species_code == "NO_KELP"
  ) %>%
  count(survey_id, sort = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys_with_NO_KELP = n(),
    total_NO_KELP_records = sum(n),
    max_records_per_survey = max(n)
  )
```

```{r}
kelp_obs_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(
    data_type == "kelp",
    species_code != "NO_KELP"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    survey_id,
    species_code
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(count_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kelp_2025_wide <- kelp_obs_2025 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species_code,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    kelp_surveys_2025,
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    survey_id,
    year,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit,
    everything()
  )
```

```{r}
kelp_2025_wide %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_all_zero = sum(
      rowSums(
        select(
          .,
          -survey_id,
          -year,
          -date,
          -site,
          -plot_type,
          -arkev_unit
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) == 0
    )
  )
```


```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_date = n_distinct(date),
    n_sites = n_distinct(site),
    n_plot_types = n_distinct(plot_type),
    n_units = n_distinct(arkev_unit)
  )

surveys_2025 %>%
  count(
    survey_id,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
grazer_obs_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(
    data_type %in% c("urchins", "tegula")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      species_code == "STRPUR" & size_cm == "<2cm" ~ "purple_urchins_<2cm",
      species_code == "STRPUR" & size_cm == ">2cm" ~ "purple_urchins_>2cm",
      species_code == "MESFRA" ~ "red_urchins",
      species_code == "TEGULA" ~ "tegula",
      species_code == "TEG_ARK" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ species_code
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  group_by(
    survey_id,
    species
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(count_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

grazer_surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(
    data_type %in% c("urchins", "tegula")
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    survey_id,
    year,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit
  )
```

```{r}
grazer_2025_wide <- grazer_surveys_2025 %>%
  left_join(
    grazer_obs_2025,
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    grazer_surveys_2025,
    by = c(
      "survey_id",
      "year",
      "date",
      "site",
      "plot_type",
      "arkev_unit"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)
    )
  )

grazer_2025_wide %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_all_zero = sum(
      rowSums(
        select(
          .,
          -survey_id,
          -year,
          -date,
          -site,
          -plot_type,
          -arkev_unit
        )
      ) == 0
    )
  )

grazer_2025_wide %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_small = sum(`purple_urchins_<2cm` > 0),
    n_large = sum(`purple_urchins_>2cm` > 0)
  )

grazer_2025_wide %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    small_urchins = sum(`purple_urchins_<2cm` >0),
    large_urchins = sum(`purple_urchins_>2cm` >0),
    red_urchins = sum(red_urchins  >0),
    tegula = sum(tegula  >0)
  )
```

```{r}
invert_2025_std <- invert_2025_wide %>%
  select(-`NA`) %>%
  rename(
    CANCERSPP = CANSPP,
    PUGPRO = PUGSPP
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      site == "Big_River" ~ "Big River",
      site == "big_river" ~ "Big River",
      site == "Noyo" ~ "Noyo",
      site == "noyo" ~ "Noyo",
      TRUE ~ site
    ),
    survey_id = as.character(survey_id),
    arkev_unit = as.character(arkev_unit)
  )

invert_2026_std <- ki %>%
  transmute(
    survey_id = as.character(survey_id),
    year = 2026,
    date,
    site = case_when(
      site == "big_river" ~ "Big River",
      site == "Big_River" ~ "Big River",
      site == "noyo" ~ "Noyo",
      site == "Noyo" ~ "Noyo",
      TRUE ~ site
    ),
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit,
    across(all_of(inverts))
  )

invert_2026_std <- invert_2026_std %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(inverts),
      ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
sort(setdiff(
  names(invert_2025_std),
  names(invert_2026_std)
))

sort(setdiff(
  names(invert_2026_std),
  names(invert_2025_std)
))
```

```{r}
invert_2025_2026 <- bind_rows(
  invert_2025_std,

) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(
        survey_id,
        year,
        date,
        site,
        plot_type,

      ),

invert_2025_2026 %>%

invert_2025_2026 %>%

    n_sites = n_distinct(site)
  )
```

```{r}
taxon_tests <- ki_2025_2026 %>%
  select(
    year, site,
    all_of(c(grazers, kelp, inverts))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(c(grazers, kelp, inverts)),
    names_to = "taxon",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(wilcox.test(abundance ~ year, exact = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = map_dbl(test, ~ unname(.x$statistic)),
    p_value = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(site, taxon, statistic, p_value) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(site, p_adjusted)
```

```{r}
community_taxa <- c(grazers, kelp, inverts)

ki_metrics <- ki_permanova %>%

    total_abundance = rowSums(
      select(., all_of(community_taxa))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ .x / 3.14,
      .names = "{.col}_density"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(

      .names = "{.col}_relative"
    )
```

```{r}
density_relative_change <- ki_metrics %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_abundance"
    ),
    across(
      all_of(paste0(community_taxa, "_density")),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    across(
      all_of(paste0(community_taxa, "_relative")),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

density_relative_change <- ki_metrics %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_abundance"
    ),
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x / 3.14, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_density"
    ),
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x / total_abundance * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_relative"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(site, year),
    names_to = c("taxon", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(abundance|density|relative)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "year_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change = year_2026 - year_2025
  )
```

```{r}
        "year2026",
```

```{R}
  mutate(
    grazer_density = rowSums(
      select(., all_of(grazers))
    ) / 3.14
  ) %>%
  select(
    site,
    year,
    grazer_density,
    all_of(four_kelp)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(four_kelp),
    names_to = "taxon",
    values_to = "kelp_density"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = factor(
      taxon,
      levels = c("NERA", "NERJ", "DESSPP")
    ),
    year = factor(year)
  )

ggplot(
  plot_dat,
  aes(
    x = grazer_density,
    y = kelp_density,
    shape = year
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.40,
    size = 1.8
  ) +

  # Same relationship estimated separately by year
  geom_smooth(
    aes(
      linetype = year
    ),
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(taxon),
    cols = vars(site),
    scales = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Kelp density in relation to grazer density",
    subtitle = "Kelp taxa with significant negative grazer-density relationships",
    x = "Grazer density (individuals / m²)",
    y = "Kelp density (individuals / m²)",
    shape = "Year",
    linetype = "Year"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = "white"
    ),

    strip.placement = "outside",

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.position = "top",

    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
cover_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type == 'algal_cover',
    month != "4") %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = case_when(
      species_code == "CRUCOR" ~ "CCA",
      species_code == "ARTCOR" ~ "ACA",
      species_code == "ENCRED" ~ "ER",
      species_code %in% c("BR", "BAREROCK") ~ "BR",
      species_code == "TURF" ~ "turf",
      species_code == "FLESHY" ~ "FLESHY",
      species_code == "SCUM" ~ "SCUM",
      species_code == "BS" ~ "SAND",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    cover = as.numeric(percent)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxon))%>%
  group_by(survey_id, year, date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit, taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    cover_raw = sum(cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cover_2025 %>%
  count(year, site, taxon)

sum(is.na(cover_2025$cover))

cover_2025 %>%
  summarise(
    min_cover = min(cover_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_cover = max(cover_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
cover_2025_adj <- cover_2025 %>%
  group_by(
    survey_id, year, date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Underlying algal cover before adjustment
    underlying_cover = sum(
      cover_raw[taxon %in% c("CCA", "ACA", "ER", "BR", "turf")],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Sand is substrate, so this is the available hard substrate
    hard_substrate = 100 - sum(
      cover_raw[taxon == "SAND"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Only scale surveys where underlying cover exceeds
    # the available hard substrate.
    scale_factor = if_else(
      underlying_cover > hard_substrate &
        underlying_cover > 0,
      hard_substrate / underlying_cover,
      1
    ),

    # Scale ALL organisms associated with hard substrate.
    # FLESHY and SCUM remain separate superlayers.
    cover_clean = cover_raw * scale_factor
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cover_2025_survey <- cover_2025_adj %>%
  group_by(
    survey_id, year, date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    CCA = sum(cover_clean[taxon == "CCA"], na.rm = TRUE),
    ACA = sum(cover_clean[taxon == "ACA"], na.rm = TRUE),
    ER = sum(cover_clean[taxon == "ER"], na.rm = TRUE),
    BR = sum(cover_clean[taxon == "BR"], na.rm = TRUE),
    turf = sum(cover_clean[taxon == "turf"], na.rm = TRUE),

    FLESHY = sum(cover_clean[taxon == "FLESHY"], na.rm = TRUE),
    SCUM = sum(cover_clean[taxon == "SCUM"], na.rm = TRUE),

    SAND = sum(cover_raw[taxon == "SAND"], na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

cover_2025_survey %>%
  mutate(
    algal_cover = CCA + ACA + ER + BR + turf,
    hard_substrate = 100 - SAND,
    difference = algal_cover - hard_substrate
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_over_hard_substrate = sum(
      difference > 0.001,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_algal = min(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_algal = median(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_algal = mean(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_algal = max(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_algal_sand = cor(algal_cover, SAND, use = "complete.obs"),
    mean_algal = mean(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sand = mean(SAND, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fleshy = mean(FLESHY, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_scum = mean(SCUM, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
cover_2025_survey %>%

      SAND > 0 & SAND <= 20 ~ "1–20% sand",
```

```{r}
cover_2026 <- cover %>%
  mutate(
    survey_id = paste(
      date,
      site,
      plot_type,
      arkev_unit,
      sep = "_"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(FR, ER, CCA, ACA, FG, brown, turf, scum, BR, SAND),
      ~ as.numeric(unlist(.))
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    year,
    month,
    date,
    survey_id,
    site = str_to_lower(str_trim(site)),
    plot_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(plot_type)),
    arkev_unit = str_trim(arkev_unit),
    CCA,
    ACA,
    ER,
    BR,
    turf,
    FLESHY = rowSums(
      cbind(FR, FG, brown),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    SCUM = scum,
    SAND
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # underlying algal layer only
    algal_cover = CCA + ACA + ER + BR + turf
  )
```

```{r}
cover_2026 %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    min_algal = min(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_algal = median(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_algal = mean(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_algal = max(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_over_100 = sum(algal_cover > 100.001, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
